entities.name: Great Magus War
entities.description: Nearly 600-year-long battle of mages, including planeswalkers, fought mostly on Antausia.

entities.name: Antausia
entities.description: Plane where most of the war took place due to its powerful, untutored magic.

entities.name: Open Lands
entities.description: Lands whose people fortified against the mages.

entities.name: Farreach
entities.description: Wastes where many mages staged their battles.

events.summary: Mages exploiting the magic fight vigilantes trying to keep them in check on Antausia.
events.quote: mages who exploited the magic for their gain were confronted by vigilantes

events.summary: Many mages stage their battles in the wastes of Farreach to protect the inhabitants.
events.quote: many mages chose to have their battles staged in the wastes of Farreach

events.summary: After nearly six hundred years, mages make battle so difficult for one another that the war ends.
events.quote: mages managed to make it so difficult for one another to battle that the war couldn't continue
